first.rationale: Verify the two most decision-relevant records: promotional pricing directly addresses current competitive losses but lacks explicit evidence on retention, account quality, and long-term economics; onboarding simplification directly addresses the completion decline but needs validation of downstream qualified-revenue impact. I currently favor simplifying onboarding because it targets a measured funnel deterioration without the margin and customer-quality risks of discounting.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable value. Reject promotional pricing for this slot: despite qualified-revenue lift, its verified 30-day retention decline of 12% creates unacceptable downstream-value risk. Longer-term qualified-revenue impact from onboarding remains uncertain, so retain an experimental holdout and measure retention and qualified revenue.
